about: The crow's hop: four poses of the body's own Hop (both feet planted and swinging back, then a bound with a wing flare), side-on, down and up, at 850 ms a tile (the pose-rate cap: a hop of 11 to 15 px across the views, drawn in four poses, holds its feet only up to about 80 px/s). Four poses a loop (DECISIONS 2026-10-29).
